text:
This encyclopedia aims to explain the historical context of every unit, building, upgrade, and other items found in 0 A.D. as well as provide interesting and related background information. It comprises several hundreds of short and sweet articles categorized by their topic, historical meaning, and relation to the game. They are written for players of any knowledge level, from novices to experienced historians. There's something to delight for everyone.
 What are you waiting for? Dive deep into the fascinating world of ancient civilizations!
